title: Costs rebuild 1.2: /kpis, workspace KPIs and the run page on the cost read
description:
Piece 2 of 3 of **LIN-4176** (Costs rebuild 1: one cost read that every surface asks). Read the scope, research and the full approved plan in **LIN-4176's description** (`## Implementation Plan`, revised 3 Nov). Read its comment trail too, especially the Approve verdict's builder notes 1 and 2 (comment `6645f289-b9a5-4dd7-a5d2-8c7ec9170fd8`). Lands after piece 1, which provides `lib/cost-read.js`, the fixture corpus and the goldens.

**Starting point.** LIN-4176's approved plan is this piece's starting point. Follow it. Where the code shows it wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4176.

## This piece's slice of the plan

**KPI path onto the read: S11 public** `/kpis` **cost per finished task, and S12 workspace KPIs cost per day.**

* Add the **raw-collection adapter** for the founder lookup, batched **per** `urlKey` \[N4\], because `{urlKey, rootItemId}` is the index and an `{$in}` without `urlKey` scans. The rows come from the Mongo projection in `lib/kpi-stats.js:449-460` / `loadDispatchHistory` `:488`. The workspace call is at `lib/workspace-kpi-stats.js:147`.
* **The founder lookup stays on the KPI path \[N3\]** for the issue, not the start. Time it on a seeded store, since the aggregation here has timed out before (LIN-3002). If it is too slow, restrict it to anchors whose earliest fetched member has a `followUpTo` (already projected, `kpi-stats.js:454`), proven by W2. Never fall back to the fetched window for the issue.
* **S11 keeps exactly today's population:** done, not skipped, with a member in the window. The component rule, the public count floor and 2dp stay in `lib/terminal-marked-task-cost.js` / `kpi-stats` as population logic, and call the read's fold. The privacy rule stays: no identifier crosses `kpi-stats.js`.
* **S12 keeps today's day bucket:** the day of the lineage's earliest *in-window* member. This is a named display rule, not fixed here.
* **Incomplete rule on S11 (review note 1):** decide whether it applies and name the choice either way. The reviewer recommends applying it, because today a done opencode straddler is folded from its in-window deltas only and counted as `fullyPriced`, an undercount shown as complete. If you apply it, add the public movement to the change list as "(d) also reaches S11: a done opencode straddler's component is no longer priced", and allow exactly that difference in W6. Piece 1's corpus has the fixture case. If you exempt S11 instead, record the silent partial under "Left, and why" on LIN-4176.

**Run and session page: S13** (`lib/run-view.js`, session loops from `routes/dashboard.js:691`). Grouping by `rootItemId ?? loopId` (`lib/pipeline-loops.js:360`) stays a display decision. Only the per-group figure and the total come from the read. Fix the display: a complete `$0` shows `$0.00`, not "not reported"; an unpriced or unreadable lineage still withholds; the total shows only when complete.

**Delete in this change:** `joinCostLineages` (`lib/dispatch-lineage.js:187`), `reduceLineageCost` (`lib/terminal-marked-task-cost.js:68`), `windowedSpend`'s reduce (`lib/weekly-budget.js:26`), and `run-view`'s `lineageCost` (`lib/run-view.js:252`). Fix S12's all-unpriced-day `$0.00` (`lib/render-workspace-kpis.js:150`). Use piece 1's `formatUsd` wherever these renderers format a figure they touch.

## Change list this piece may show in the replay

* (b) On S11/S12, the same lineage set, but a straddler's ticket is credited to its founder's issue. The replay lists every lineage whose issue moves on the public path.
* (d) S12 no longer shows `$0.00` for an all-unpriced day; S13 shows a complete `$0.00`; S11 incomplete per your note-1 decision.
* Nothing else.

## Testing

* **W2**, KPI part: S11/S12 select the same lineage set as the golden; the straddler's ticket is credited to LIN-42; S12 puts it in the golden's day bucket.
* **W5**, S13/S12 part (tries the softened guard): an unpriced lineage and an unreadable lineage still show "not reported"; a complete 0 shows `$0.00`; an all-unpriced S12 day is not `$0.00`; `formatUsd(null/undefined)` never returns a dollar figure.
* **W6** `/kpis` unchanged: the replay of `computeTerminalMarkedTaskCost` and the public block equals the golden except (b) credits and, if taken, the note-1 movement. **Assert what is true today (review note 2):** the cost card's lineage set equals the outcome rate's lineages that have at least one `taken` member, and no lineage is in the cost set but not the outcome set. The outcome grouping also keeps never-ran lineages (`lib/dispatch-lineage.js:137-160`). Run this assertion at HEAD first. `kpi-stats-pins` and the privacy assertion stay green.
* **W4**, this piece's part: S1 = S13's group figures; S12's period sum = S11's per-lineage costs over the same lineages; S5's 30-day total = S12's 30-day sum over the lineages both count \[N5\]. The replay lists any lineage one counts and the other does not, with its reason.
* **W9**, for S11/S12/S13: every replay difference is on the change list.
* The founder-lookup timing on the seeded store is reported in the PR.

**Done when:** S11, S12 and S13 read from `cost-read`; the four copies above are deleted; the S12 and S13 display fixes are in; the note-1 decision is made and named; W2 (KPI part), W4 (part), W5 (part), W6 and W9 (part) are green; the lookup timing is in the PR.

Session fit: fits one session

Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4176's approving plan-review (comment 6645f289-b9a5-4dd7-a5d2-8c7ec9170fd8, rev 2)

Grounding commits: Harbour `main` `9e397e6b` (tidy 5 at `46b43b3b`); runner `5379817`. Re-grounded at breakdown on 3 Nov; nothing has moved since.

## Implemented (close-out stub)

Implemented as approved in PR [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2262](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2262>), merged as `0dc1620e` (squash of `05b2b703` + `ed66caae`), deployed and live. S11, S12 and S13 read from `lib/cost-read.js`; the four older copies are deleted; the S12 and S13 display fixes are in; the note-1 decision is applied on S11 (a done opencode straddler is no longer priced). Deviations from the plan: none beyond the review-requested tests and the internal `terminalMarkedTaskCostDetail` (counted anchors, never public). The scope, "Testing" and "Done when" sections above are kept as the acceptance record. Full pre-close description is preserved in the task snapshots (`GET /api/proxy/issues/LIN-4178/snapshots`) and the comment trail. Outside follow-up: LIN-4184 (S12 day-bucket population).

comments.body: LIN-4177 (piece 1) is merged and deployed: PR #2261, `10b2c82f`. Goldens for S1–S13 are recorded at `9e397e6b` in `tests/fixtures/cost-replay/`, including S2–S4, S7 and S11–S13 and the done, anchored opencode straddler (`so`), so this piece can diff against a true before. `lib/cost-read.js` is the single lineage-cost read; do not add a second representation. Two open post-deploy checks (live mixed-harness tally, founder-lookup latency) are recorded on LIN-4177.

**LIN-4178 done for review: PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2262** (commit `05b2b703`, branch `feat/lin-4178-kpis-run-page-cost-read`)

**Evidence**
- CI on 05b2b703: `CI success` pass; unit tests pass (22,680 passing, 0 failing locally); E2E shards 1–4 pass (64 specs run locally across kpis, workspace-kpis, session-page, run-evidence, escalation-kpis); secret scan pass.
- Replay (`scripts/cost-replay.mjs`): every difference from the goldens is on `expected-changes.json`; W9 green.
- Founder lookup timing (real mongod 8.2, production indexes): 200k lineages, horizon read 7979 ms, full founder lookup 4926 ms, narrowed variant 957 ms. Full lookup kept as default; narrowing is the fallback if the reviewer judges it too slow.

**Decisions** (also on LIN-4176)
- S11 incomplete rule applied: done opencode straddler LIN-8 no longer priced (pricedTicketCount 11 → 10).
- S11 golden re-recorded at 9e397e6b over the horizon-filtered rows that `/kpis` reads.
- S12 population kept as today (earliest fetched member in the window); "any member" would move lineage P. Flagged as a follow-up ruling.

**Left for piece 3 (LIN-4179):** S2/S3/S4/S7 call-log reads, remaining USD formatters, census and agreement tests, docs beyond the source-map lines.

## Review — LIN-4178

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2262, head `05b2b70391eabd1aeca559e2a7d27c664cc8f182` (one commit on `10b2c82f`). No commits have landed on `main` since the ticket was created, so the plan's file and line references still hold.

CI: green on `05b2b703`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan and `CI success` all pass. I also re-ran the 9 cost/KPI unit files locally on the head (192 pass, 0 fail).

### What the code does (verified)
- **Scope matches the plan.** S11, S12 and S13 read from `lib/cost-read.js` (`lineageRecords`, `lineageFigure`, `lineageFigureOf`, `usageStateOf`). The four copies are deleted: `joinCostLineages`, `reduceLineageCost`, `windowedSpend`'s reduce and `run-view`'s `lineageCost` body. I grepped `lib routes public scripts server.js` and found no remaining callers. `formatUsd` replaces the local formatters in `render-kpis`, `render-workspace-kpis` and `render-run-steps`. The plan was not overrun. The only new modules are `lib/founder-lookup.js` (the planned raw-collection adapter) and the timing script.
- **Founder lookup.** It is batched per `urlKey` with 500 anchors per `$in`, reads both collections, uses `LINEAGE_IDENTITY_PROJECTION`, has no `since` or cap, and is injected into `kpi-stats.js` (not imported). That respects the plan's N3/N4 and the privacy boundary. `loadDispatchHistory` projects `urlKey` and `rootItemId` (`kpi-stats.js:452-453`), so the lookup is never silently empty in production.
- **Re-recorded S11 golden checked independently.** I ran baseline `9e397e6b`'s `computeTerminalMarkedTaskCost` over the PR's corpus. Unfiltered rows give 9 / 74.28 / 0.857, the old golden. Horizon-filtered rows give **11 / 79.88 / 0.824**, the new golden. History-on-horizon plus all queue rows (production's exact read) gives the same result, because the corpus has no queue row older than the horizon. The re-record is a correct baseline, not a moved goalpost.
- **Note-1 decision** (incomplete rule applied on S11) is made, named, and on the change list as (d). Its unit witness goes red under mutation.
- **Timing.** The full lookup adds about 60% to the existing horizon read: 4.9 s on top of 8.0 s at 200k lineages. It runs on a 60 s cache with warm-stale serving. I accept the full lookup as the default. The live check is the latency check already open on LIN-4177.
- **Regression check.** `run-view`/`render-run-steps` previously withheld any figure ≤ 0 (LIN-4136, "the plan forbids ever rendering 0"). LIN-4176's W5 loosens this on purpose, and it is tested. Nothing that was reverted has come back.

### Mutation check (LIN-2274)
I ran each mutation against the cost/KPI test files and reverted every one.

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| S13: `fmtUsd` returns null for 0 again | **red** (W5) |
| S13: `run-view` needs `costUsd > 0` | **red** |
| `lineageFigure` ignores `incomplete` | **red** (note-1 witness) |
| founder lookup drops `urlKey` from the query | **red** |
| `usageStateOf` ignores `usageEntry` (aggregation shape) | **red** |
| **S12 all-unpriced fix reverted** (`perDay` back to `roundTo4(byDay.get(day) \|\| 0)`, `workspace-kpi-stats.js:105`) | **green** |
| **`kpi-stats.js` stops passing `identityRows`** to `computeTerminalMarkedTaskCost` (`:1140`) | **green** |
| **`workspace-kpi-stats.js` founder lookup replaced by `[]`** (`:175`) | **green** |
| S11 population drops the `skipped` filter / ignores the window | green (the window is a no-op by design, since horizon = window; the cause of `skipped` staying green is the same as finding 3) |

### Findings
1. **W9 only checks one direction, so three of this piece's deliverables have no witness.** `tests/unit/cost-read.test.js:205-211` fails on a difference that is *not* listed, but never on a listed change that *did not happen*. So reverting the S12 all-unpriced `$0.00` fix, the LIN-8 movement on `S12.daily.cost.perDay.26` / `pricedCount`, or the workspace founder lookup keeps every test green. W5's "an all-unpriced S12 day is not `$0.00`" is witnessed only on the render side (`render-workspace-kpis.test.js:254` feeds `null` in by hand). I probed it: making W9 two-way passes today (80 diffs, all 27 listed paths do differ), so the fix is mechanical.
2. **The /kpis production wiring for the founder lookup is untested.** Every `collectKpiStats` test passes `NO_FOUNDERS` (`kpi-stats-reads-pin.test.js:65`, `mongo-smoke.test.js:1944,1948`), and the replay calls `computeTerminalMarkedTaskCost` directly. Deleting `{ identityRows }` at `kpi-stats.js:1140` therefore leaves W2 (KPI part) and the S11 note-1 movement unverified on the real path.
3. **The W6 note-2 assertion does not exercise production code.** `tests/unit/cost-read-outcome-sets.test.js` rebuilds both the "cost set" and the "outcome set" inside the test from `groupLineageMembership`, with the same filter. It never touches `computeTerminalMarkedTaskCost`'s population or the outcome rate's own dating (`kpi-stats.js:824`). Both population mutations above stay green. Review note 2 asked for the cost card's actual set to be asserted against the outcome rate's actual set.

All three sit inside this ticket's bounded classes: W2 (KPI part), W5 (S12 part), W6 and W9 (part) are this piece's named acceptance gates.

### Isolated, or one of a class?
- **Class: "a replay change list that only allows, never requires."** The one W9 test covers every surface, so the same gap also weakens piece 1's (a)/(b)/(c) entries, and it will weaken piece 3's. Fixing it once here covers all of them (**inside**: W9 part).
- **Class: "an injected dependency stubbed empty in every test"** (finding 2). I found no other instance in this diff. The store-side `lineageIdentityRows` stubs return real rows. Isolated.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **inside** (W9/W5, S12): making W9 two-way and witnessing the S12 all-unpriced fix end to end. Fix: in `tests/unit/cost-read.test.js` W9, also assert that every `changes[].path` matches at least one diff. Better still, pin each S11/S12/S13 entry's after-value. Settled before merge by a test run in which reverting `workspace-kpi-stats.js:105` to `roundTo4(spend.byDay.get(day) || 0)` goes red.
- **inside** (W2 KPI part, S11): the /kpis path really credits founders. Fix: add a `collectKpiStats` test whose `lineageIdentity` returns a straddler's founder row and asserts the public `terminalMarkedTaskCost` differs from the `NO_FOUNDERS` run (for example, the LIN-8 opencode straddler drops `pricedTicketCount`). Settled before merge by the `kpi-stats.js:1140` mutation going red.
- **inside** (W6, review note 2): assert the card's real population. Fix: expose the counted anchors from `computeTerminalMarkedTaskCost`, for example on a non-public second return or an internal helper. It must never reach `toPublicKpis`, so the privacy assertion holds. Assert those anchors ⊆ the outcome rate's in-window lineages (as `computeDispatchOutcomes` dates them) and equal those with a `taken` member. Settled before merge: the test goes red under the "drop the skipped filter" mutation (`terminal-marked-task-cost.js:183`), and the assertion first passes at HEAD.
- **inside** (founder lookup on the KPI path, N3): cold `/kpis` latency with the full lookup in production. A seeded store cannot show the production row count or the number of workspaces. Settled after deploy by the founder-lookup latency check already recorded on LIN-4177: time a cold `/kpis` collect. If it is too slow, switch to the narrowed `followUpTo` variant (957 ms at 200k in the PR's table), proven by W2.
- **outside**: the S12 population ruling the implementer raised ("earliest fetched member in window" vs "any member", lineage `P`). The ticket says to keep today's bucket, and that is what was built. Whether the window should move is a separate product question for close-out to route if no ruling already covers it. This ticket does not depend on it.
- **inside** (S13 display, manual): `$0.00` on a real session page for a complete-zero lineage, and "not reported" for unpriced/unreadable lineages. The unit and replay tests cover `buildRunView`/`render-session`. Settled after deploy by opening a session whose lineage has a complete `costUsd: 0` usage row.

### Verdict
**Request Changes.** The behaviour is correct and matches the plan, and the re-recorded golden is verified. But three of this piece's own acceptance witnesses (W9 two-way, the /kpis founder wiring, the W6 population assertion) can be broken without any test going red. Next action: `implementation`, to add the three tests named in the ledger. No production code change is needed except, for the W6 fix, exposing the population anchors internally. After that, review re-runs.

**LIN-4178 revision for review: PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2262** (head `ed66caae`, on `05b2b703`, same branch, no new PR)

**Findings from the Request Changes review, and their fixes**

1. **W9 was one-directional.** The replay test only forbade unlisted differences. It now also fails for any change-list entry the replay does not show, and the S11/S12/S13 movements are pinned to their after-values (S11 10 tickets / 79.48; S12 days 23/25/28 no figure, day 26 1.2, pricedCount 3122; `zr` priced at $0; `hk` still withholds).
   Mutations, each restored afterwards: S12 all-unpriced fix reverted → red, and the two-way check names `perDay.23/25/28`. Workspace founder lookup replaced by `[]` → red on day 26.
2. **The `/kpis` founder wiring had no test.** New witnesses drive `collectKpiStats` through the real `lookupFounderRows` and pin the `server.js` wiring line. The straddler is credited to LIN-42 (two tickets, 5.00 summed once). The public page carries no LIN-42/LIN-99 identifier. Mutation: `kpi-stats.js:1140` `identityRows` dropped → red (`actual 1, expected 2`).
3. **The W6 check rebuilt both sets inside the test.** `computeTerminalMarkedTaskCost` keeps its shape and now delegates to `terminalMarkedTaskCostDetail`, which also returns the counted anchors. The test compares them with the outcome rate's in-window lineages and with the taken-member rows. The corpus has no in-window `[skipped]` lineage, so the test adds one explicitly. Mutation: skipped filter dropped (`terminal-marked-task-cost.js:202`) → red (`cost lineage sk is in the outcome rate`). The anchors are internal; `toPublicKpis` never sees them.

**Figures are unchanged.** The replay differs from the goldens only on `expected-changes.json`.

**Evidence**
- Commit `ed66caae`, pushed to `feat/lin-4178-kpis-run-page-cost-read`.
- CI on `ed66caae`: Unit tests pass (8m27s), E2E shards 1–4 pass, Secret scan pass, `CI success` pass. Run 41742353161.
- Full local unit suite: 22,689 pass, 0 fail.

**Not done here:** the cold `/kpis` founder-lookup latency check stays open on LIN-4177, as the review recorded.

## Review — LIN-4178

Re-review of PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2262 at head `ed66caaeed333da1c57f355ebd16632c99bab14a`. It is two commits on `10b2c82f`: `05b2b703` (reviewed before) and `ed66caae` (the review fixes). `main` is still at `10b2c82f`, so nothing has landed since the ticket was created and the plan's references still hold. The PR is mergeable.

CI: green on `ed66caae`. Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan and `CI success` all pass. I also ran the 15 cost/KPI/run-view unit files locally on the head: 369 pass, 0 fail.

### What the revision changes (verified)
- **Scope.** Four files changed. Only one is production code: `lib/terminal-marked-task-cost.js`. `computeTerminalMarkedTaskCost` now delegates to `terminalMarkedTaskCostDetail`, which returns `{figures, countedAnchors}`. The public function returns only `figures`, so its shape is unchanged. `countedAnchors.add` sits right after the window and skipped filters and before `ranLineages++`, so it is exactly the population the figures are summed over. `kpi-stats.js:1140` still calls the figures-only function, so the anchors never reach `toPublicKpis`. The privacy test (`doesNotMatch /LIN-42|LIN-99/` on `toPublicKpis`) passes. The figures are unchanged, and the replay still differs from the goldens only on `expected-changes.json`.
- **Finding 1 (W9 one-way): fixed.** `cost-read.test.js` now also fails on any listed change that did not happen. It also pins the after-values for S11 (10 / 79.48), S12 (days 23/25/28 null, day 26 = 1.2, pricedCount 3122) and S13 (`zr` priced at 0, `hk` not reported).
- **Finding 2 (/kpis founder wiring): fixed.** `collectKpiStats` now runs through the real `lookupFounderRows` over a filter-honouring collection stub. With the lookup the card counts 2 tickets; without it, 1. The `server.js:2497` call is pinned by a source regex. That regex only pins the arguments. The behaviour is witnessed by the `collectKpiStats` test, so this is acceptable.
- **Finding 3 (W6 rebuilt sets): fixed.** The cost side is now the card's real `countedAnchors`. The outcome side is `groupDispatchLineages`' `earliest` dating with skipped excluded. The "taken member" side is derived from raw row fields, so it does not share the production filter. An explicit in-window `[skipped]` row witnesses the skipped rule without moving the goldens.

### Mutation check (LIN-2274), each one reverted, worktree clean afterwards
| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| S12 all-unpriced fix reverted (`workspace-kpi-stats.js:105` → `roundTo4(spend.byDay.get(day) \|\| 0)`) | **red**: W9 two-way and the S12 after-value pin |
| `kpi-stats.js:1140` stops passing `{ identityRows }` | **red**: the founder-wiring test (LIN-42 credit) |
| workspace founder lookup replaced by `[]` (`workspace-kpi-stats.js:175`) | **red**: W9 two-way and the S12 day-26/pricedCount pin |
| skipped filter dropped (`terminal-marked-task-cost.js:202`) | **red**: both W6 tests plus the existing F5 skipped test |

All three mutations that stayed green in the last review now go red. The window-filter mutation still stays green by design: the horizon equals the window, as the previous review recorded.

### Regression check
`git log` on the touched files shows only `05b2b703`, `ed66caae` and piece 1's `10b2c82f`. Nothing has been reverted or re-applied. The intentional loosening of LIN-4136's "never render 0" stays as approved under W5.

### Isolated, or one of a class?
The class "a change list that only allows, never requires" is now closed for every surface, because the one W9 test is shared. Piece 3's entries get the two-way check for free. I found no other instance of "an injected dependency stubbed empty in every test" in this diff. Isolated.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **inside** (founder lookup on the KPI path, N3): cold `/kpis` latency with the full lookup at production row counts and workspace counts. The seeded-store timing is 4.9 s on top of 8.0 s at 200k lineages, behind the 60 s warm-stale cache. **After the deploy:** time a cold `/kpis` collect. This is the latency check already recorded on LIN-4177. If it is too slow, switch to the narrowed `followUpTo` variant (957 ms at 200k), proven by W2. Not discharged.
- **inside** (S13 display, manual): this needs a real session page. A lineage with a complete `costUsd: 0` usage row must show `$0.00`. An unpriced or unreadable lineage must still show "not reported", and the total must appear only when complete. `buildRunView`, the replay and the E2E session-page specs cover this, but no live page was opened. **After the deploy:** open such a session and check. Not discharged.
- **outside**: the S12 population ruling ("earliest fetched member in window" vs "any member", lineage `P`). The ticket kept today's rule, and that is what was built. No ruling row exists for LIN-4178 (`rulings?includeResolved=true` returned 0). Close-out should route it as a product question if no ticket covers it already. This ticket does not depend on it.

### Verdict
**Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger.** All three findings from the last review are fixed, and each witness goes red under its mutation. CI is green on `ed66caae`, and the only items left are the two post-deploy checks and one outside follow-up.

## Close-out — LIN-4178

**Merged:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2262, squash commit `0dc1620eacdc9b050d42d4e05c4a314e55664018`, pinned with `--match-head-commit ed66caaeed333da1c57f355ebd16632c99bab14a` (the head review approved). Deployed: harbour.cat footer shows `0dc1620`.

**Authority:** the re-review recorded "Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger".

**Changes I made after the approval:** none. The review asked for no further fixes (its three earlier findings were fixed in `ed66caae` and re-verified by review), so nothing new went in unreviewed.

**CI:** CI exists. On `ed66caae`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, `CI success` all pass (run 41742353161), read fresh before merge. Post-merge run on `main` (41744024546): success.

**Ledger**
- inside — cold `/kpis` founder-lookup latency at production scale: **not run to completion.** After the deploy, `/kpis` answers in ~50 ms (3 requests, 200, cost card renders "Cost per finished task"), but that is the 60 s warm cache; I have no way from here to force a cold collect or see production row counts, so this is not a cold timing. Not run: what = time a cold `/kpis` collect with the full lookup; why = no access to the production process/cache; who = the operator. If too slow, switch to the narrowed `followUpTo` variant (957 ms at 200k in the PR's table). The same check is already open on LIN-4177.
- inside — S13 live session page (`$0.00` for a complete-zero lineage, "not reported" for unpriced/unreadable, total only when complete): **not run.** Needs an authenticated session page with a complete `costUsd: 0` lineage; I have no browser session. Who can run it: the operator, by opening such a session on harbour.cat. Covered meanwhile by the unit/replay tests and the E2E session-page specs (CI green).
- outside — S12 population ruling ("earliest fetched member in window" vs "any member", lineage `P`): filed as **LIN-4184** (Low, `kind:decision` + `front:cost-economy`, related to LIN-4178). No existing ticket or ruling row covered it (searched; `rulings?includeResolved=true` returned 0).
- Named monitor/rollback: review named none; none supplied.

**Closed with the two post-deploy checks recorded as not run**, per the close-out rules (the deploy landed; a check I cannot run does not hold the close).

**Related tickets:** LIN-4177 stays Done; its open latency check is the same one above (noted there). LIN-4176 stays In Progress (piece 3, LIN-4179, remains). LIN-4179 is unblocked.

## Survey 1a (round 3)

**1. Why was this difficult?** It wasn't hard in the usual sense. The behaviour was already right; the work was making tests that could actually fail. Three things got in the way:
- The replay's change list only *allowed* differences and never *required* them. A reverted fix still passed.
- The founder lookup reaches `kpi-stats.js` as an injected function, to keep the privacy boundary. That is the right design, but every test passed it as empty, so the real path was never exercised.
- `computeTerminalMarkedTaskCost` returned only figures, so the card's population couldn't be observed without changing production code.

The real snag was W6. My first version stayed green when I dropped the skipped filter, the mutation the reviewer named. The corpus had no in-window `[skipped]` lineage at all. I added one inside the test rather than in the corpus, so the goldens wouldn't move.

**2. What would I have done first?** Run the reviewer's mutations against my new tests before writing more of them. And check that the corpus actually holds the case each witness depends on. Either would have caught the skipped gap at once instead of after a green run.

**3. What would I tidy?**
- Key S13 steps by `lineageId` in `diff.js`. Today a path like `S13.steps.implementation#8` is "the 8th implementation step", which shifts if a step is added.
- Move the after-values into `expected-changes.json`, so W9 checks values directly. That would remove the separate pins, which partly repeat the goldens.
- Replace the `server.js` source-regex pin with a named factory (e.g. `kpiLineageIdentity(collections)`) that both the server and the test call. A regex on source text is brittle.

**4. If this area were how I'd want it, what would the ticket have been?** Just "move S11/S12/S13 onto cost-read." The cost card would expose its population as an internal result. The change list would be a two-way spec with after-values. The lookup wiring would be one shared function. The witnesses would then mostly come for free, not need a second round.

**5. What did the ticket or plan get wrong?**
- W9 was written as "every replay difference is on the change list": one-directional by wording, which is how the gap got built.
- Review note 2 assumed the corpus could witness the skipped rule. It couldn't.
- "Run this assertion at HEAD first" couldn't literally be done. Exposing the counted anchors needs the production change, so the assertion exists only on the new code. Instead I checked that the change was purely additive (figures and replay unchanged) and that the assertion goes red under mutation.

## Survey 1a q6 (the place)

**New, without an obvious home.** `terminalMarkedTaskCostDetail` is a production export whose only reader is a test. It is the honest way to see the card's population, but nothing in production uses `countedAnchors`, so it looks like dead surface to a future reader. The `server.js` wiring is pinned by a source regex in a test, which sits oddly between code and assertion.

**Now in two places.**
- The W6 test inlines `anchorOfRow`, a copy of `anchorOf` in `lineage-membership.js`. I copied it on purpose to keep the test independent, but it is still a copy.
- The `/kpis` test's fake `collection()` is a third in-memory collection, alongside `kpi-stats.test.js`'s mock and the replay harness's fake store.
- The S11/S12/S13 after-value pins partly repeat what the goldens already hold.
- The founder-lookup wiring is in `server.js` and again in `capture-kpis.mjs` and the test.

**Didn't learn about it.** The other `collectKpiStats` tests still pass empty founders. `source-map.md` doesn't mention the detail export or that W9 is now two-way. Piece 3 inherits the stricter W9 without being told.

**Simpler.** The PR as a whole deleted four copied cost reducers. S11, S12 and S13 now read one cost read. The two-way W9 now catches a reverted change for every piece, not just this one.

**On balance:** better. One cost representation instead of five, and witnesses that actually fail. The cost is some test scaffolding and one test-only export that a factory or shared fake would tidy away.
